Class Sys

public inherited sharing class Sys

Extension of System class providing enhanced system-level utilities. Includes debug logging with automatic trace information (class name, method name, line number), supporting string and JSON output formats. Also provides convenience methods for asynchronous operations such as enqueuing Flow interviews. Uses singleton pattern for internal operations and leverages stack trace parsing for contextual debugging.

Group:
    Utilities

Since:
    03/17/2023

Version:
    1.3

  • 03/07/2026 - v1.2 - Added enqueueFlow() method for asynchronous Flow interview execution
  • 03/17/2026 - v1.3 - Added getStandardPricebookId() method for cached standard Pricebook2 retrieval

private Sys.DebugInfo getDebugInfo()

Extracts debug trace information from the current stack trace by generating a DmlException and parsing its stack trace string. Filters out internal Sys class calls to identify the actual calling location. Returns a DebugInfo object with parsed trace details.

Returns:
    DebugInfo: Parsed debug information containing class, method, line, and column details

private static Sys getInstance()

Retrieves the singleton instance of the Sys class, creating it if it doesn't exist. Implements lazy initialization pattern for the singleton instance.

Returns:
    Sys: The singleton instance of the Sys class

@AuraEnabled(cacheable=true)
public static Id getStandardPricebookId()

Retrieves the Id of the standard Pricebook2, using the org cache (Cache.Org) to avoid repeated SOQL queries. On cache miss, queries the Pricebook2 object for the standard pricebook (or uses Test.getStandardPricebookId() in test context) and caches the result for 48 hours. Exposed as @AuraEnabled(Cacheable=true) for use in Lightning components.

Returns:
    Id: The standard Pricebook2 Id

Since:
    03/17/2026

private void log(
  String label,
  Object bodyMessage,
  Boolean showTraceInfo
)

Core logging method that writes formatted debug messages to the debug log. Conditionally includes trace information (class, method, line number) based on the showTraceInfo parameter. Formats output using predefined message templates and optional label.

Parameters:
    label – Optional string label to include in the debug message
    bodyMessage – Object message content to log
    showTraceInfo – Boolean flag to enable/disable trace information inclusion
